info.name: PLN EMI Backend API
info.description:
All endpoints of backend-emi-compro. See docs/api.md for full rules.

Auth uses the `pln_emi.sid` session cookie: run **Auth > Login** first; Postman keeps the cookie. Write requests (POST/PUT/DELETE) must send an `Origin` matching the server's `FRONTEND_ORIGIN`; the collection pre-request script adds it from the `frontendOrigin` variable.

exec: // The server rejects unsafe methods without the configured frontend Origin.
